title: Sprint Planning and Client Demo Preparation
summary: The team finalized the sprint plan ahead of the client demo next Tuesday. Key dependencies were addressed, including the completion of the notifications API and frontend integration. A decision was made to deploy to staging on Friday to allow for weekend smoke testing. Action items were assigned for API development, bug fixes, documentation updates, and test planning.
key_points: The REST API for the notifications module is currently blocking frontend development.
Meera will complete the notifications API by Thursday.
Siddharth will integrate the frontend by end of day Friday.
Arjun is investigating a session token expiration bug on iOS Safari.
The team agreed to deploy to staging on Friday, October 23rd.
Siddharth will update the API documentation in Confluence by the end of next week.
Kavya will prepare the regression test plan by Wednesday.
Rohan will send the meeting summary and updated sprint board by tomorrow.
decisions: Deploy to staging on Friday, October 23rd.

action_items.task: Integrate frontend with the notifications API
Investigate and fix the session token expiration bug on iOS Safari
Write and share the regression test plan
Send out meeting summary and updated sprint board
